name: Airtable

endpoints.summary: List the bases your token can access
List records in a table (replace {baseId} and {tableIdOrName})

params.name: view
params.description: Return rows from a specific view

docsDigest: Airtable Web API (v0). Auth: Bearer personal access token; its scopes and base access decide what you can read or write. Substitute {baseId} (looks like appXXXXXXXX) and {tableIdOrName} in the path. Create and update send a JSON records array; reads support maxRecords, view and filterByFormula. Roughly 5 requests per second per base.
notes: Keyless template. Add your Airtable personal access token locally in Skales (Settings, API Connector) and confirm the base host. Scope the token to only the bases you need.
